Frequently asked questions

What's the difference between Manage and Manage + Post?

Both cover up to three platforms with trend research; Manage + Post (£129 a month) includes daily posting for you.

Do I approve posts?

Yes. Content is shared with you for approval before it goes live.

Is ad spend included?

No. Ad spend is paid to the platform and quoted separately.
